source.stem:
Multiple choice question: Which of the following statements about gymnosperms and angiosperms is correct ( )
A. The seeds of gymnosperms are covered with pericarp.
B. The seeds of angiosperms are exposed
C. Gymnosperm seeds are exposed
D. The cones of gymnosperms are fruits

options.text: The seeds of gymnosperms are covered by a pericarp
The seeds of angiosperms are exposed
The cones of gymnosperms are fruits

intelligence.enrichment: Plants and animals can be grouped on the basis of similarities and differences in their features, and different students may choose different common features for grouping. chosen_common_feature -> group_membership The learner correctly applies this rule: Plants and animals can be grouped on the basis of similarities and differences in their features, and different students may choose different common features for grouping. There is one official grouping, such as height for plants and food for animals, so a different observable feature is automatically wrong.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Diversity in the living world. The student must decide: Choose a valid basis for grouping plants or animals from their similarities and differences. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Rewrite the figure and the stem so they agree. Exactly one visual. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
